subject: Sponsor lift & buy-path summary — Lumera Health discovery
messages:
From: Tom Blake <tom.blake@lumerahealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: Asha Menon <asha.menon@lumerahealth.com>, jillian.park@lumerahealth.com
Date: Thu, 10 Dec 2026 15:23:00 -0800
Subject: Follow-up from discovery — sponsor alignment ask

Soojin / Rishi,

Thanks again for the 30-min discovery earlier today. Quick note from our side to capture what matters at the exec level and what we need to move this forward:

Top pain we shared:
- Fraudulent claims and manual reconciliation across multiple data feeds; 3X false-positive rate on current ML triggers.
- Prediction latency preventing real-time intervention at point-of-care.

Desired business outcomes (C-suite):
- 40% reduction in manual review volume within 6 months of pilot.
- Sub-200ms inference for live routing on peak traffic.

Risks & gating items our legal/compliance team flagged:
- Data residency for test datasets (must stay in us-east-1).
- SOC2 evidence, encryption key ownership, and audit logs.

Procurement path ask:
- We want an executive one-pager for our CFO (Asha) summarizing value, risk mitigations, and a realistic contracting timeline.
- Proposed timeline: pilot kickoff in Q1 (Jan) with procurement complete by end of Jan.

Can you produce a short sponsor-facing memo that I can share with Asha by Monday? Also include a recommended escalation lane if we hit unresolved vendor security questions.

Tom
Director of Data Science
Lumera Health

Attachments: Lumera_Security_Reqs.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com>
To: Tom Blake <tom.blake@lumerahealth.com>, Asha Menon <asha.menon@lumerahealth.com>
Cc: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 09:08:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Follow-up from discovery — sponsor alignment ask

Tom / Asha,

Appreciate the clear summary — been pulled into a concise sponsor memo below for Asha. Highlighting where Redwood will remove risk and what we expect from Lumera to keep decision velocity high.

Sponsor memo (one-pager highlights)
- Business outcomes: target a 40% reduction in manual reviews within 6 months; measurable via weekly review volume and mean time-to-resolution (MTTR). Pilot scope: claims routing (top 2 feeds) + live inference endpoint.
- Performance SLA: aiming for 95th percentile <200ms for 512-token average requests during pilot; we'll instrument traces for each token-phase and share dashboards.
- Data handling & residency: Pilot data will reside in us-east-1 (Redwood Private/VPC option). Customer-managed KMS is supported; we recommend HSM-backed keys if Lumera requires strict key control.
- Compliance evidence: we can provide our SOC2 summary and audit logs export (see attached SOC2_summary.pdf). If additional evidence is required, please surface the specific controls.
- Procurement runway: typical path we see that shortens timeline: (1) Sponsor approval -> (2) Security questionnaire + 1-week review -> (3) Pilot SOW + PO -> (4) Pilot kickoff. With active sponsor support and a named legal contact, we can normally close contracting in ~3–5 weeks. For an accelerated Jan kickoff, we suggest prioritizing the security checklist this week.
- Escalation lanes: primary contact — Soojin Lee (eng-sponsor alignment); security escalation — Ben Carter (security partnerships); executive escalation — Rishi Malhotra (head of sales ops). If security blockers persist beyond 7 business days, Rishi will schedule an executive sync with Lumera security and our CISO.

Action items (who/when)
- Lumera: return completed security checklist + confirm legal contact by Mon 12/14 — Tom/Asha
- Redwood: produce sponsor one-pager + SOW template by Mon 12/14 — Soojin
- Redwood Security: preliminary SOC2 export + short mapping of controls to Lumera checklist by Fri 12/11 (attached) — Ben
- Sales Ops: prepare contracting cadence and draft PO template — Rishi (ETA 12/17)

Open questions for clarity
- Which feed(s) are highest priority for the pilot (Tom mentioned two; please confirm names and expected daily volume).
- Any non-negotiable encryption/archival retention policies?

I'll attach the one-pager and SOC2 summary as separate files and drop a short version you can paste into Asha's inbox. If this looks right, I'll loop legal and schedule the security deep-dive for next week.

Best,
Sojo (So you don't get confused — Soojin)
So ojin Lee
Senior Solutions Lead, Redwood Inference
soojin_lee@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0142

Attachments: Redwood_SOC2_summary.pdf (pdf), Sponsor_OnePager_Lumera.docx (docx)

From: rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, tom.blake@lumerahealth.com
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, asha.menon@lumerahealth.com
Date: Fri, 11 Dec 2026 11:12:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Follow-up from discovery — sponsor alignment ask

Adding procurement and contracting context from Redwood ops side.

Rishi here — quick notes to keep momentum:
- Contracting model: we recommend starting with a timeboxed pilot SOW (60 days) with a capped spend for Dedicated units. Pilot SOW reduces legal back-and-forth vs full enterprise license.
- Pricing signal: for the pilot scope you described, expect a mid-five-figure pilot commitment (USD) for reserved Dedicated throughput. We can provide a quoted not-to-exceed number once feeds and QPS are confirmed.
- PO/legal contacts: please share Lumera's procurement email (contracts@lumerahealth.com or contact name). I will assign our contracts specialist to the thread.
- Escalation playbook: if Security sign-off stalls, we will: 1) open an immediate technical deep-dive (within 48 hours), 2) provide temporary data-scoping measures (anonymized subset in us-east-1), and 3) offer a time-limited SOC2 + engineer office-hours window to unblock.

Will draft a short contracting checkbox that Soojin can include in the sponsor memo.

-Rishi
Head of Sales Ops, Redwood Inference

On Fri, Dec 11, 2026 at 09:08 AM Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.com> wrote:
> Tom / Asha,
> 
> Appreciate the clear summary — been pulled into a concise sponsor memo below for Asha. Highlighting where Redwood will remove risk and what we expect from Lumera to keep decision velocity high.

From: Asha Menon <asha.menon@lumerahealth.com>
To: soojin_lee@redwood.com, rishi_malhotra@redwood.com
Cc: tom.blake@lumerahealth.com, jillian.park@lumerahealth.com
Date: Sat, 12 Dec 2026 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: RE: Follow-up from discovery — sponsor alignment ask

Soojin / Rishi,

Thank you — this is exactly the format I need for the CFO briefing. Two quick clarifications before I share:
1) Can you add a one-line expected time-to-value metric (e.g., "first measurable reduction in manual reviews within 30 days of pilot instrumented")?
2) For the procurement path, put the security checklist as a gating step but note that we can start technical onboarding on anonymized data while legal completes paperwork.

I'll get our procurement contact (contracts@lumerahealth.com) to you by EOD Monday. If we can get the sponsor one-pager and the SOW template by Monday noon, I'll present it at our executive review on Tuesday.

Best,
Asha Menon
CFO, Lumera Health
